parsed.title: Paywall Decline Guest Services Pass
parsed.oneLiner: Offer a 15-minute trial of Luzia+ services via a rewarded mini-game after a user declines the account setup paywall.
parsed.trigger: User taps Maybe later on Create Account Sheet and returns to Services Tab without subscribing.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying guest users without an account who have dismissed the Create Account Sheet paywall.

offer.title: Try Luzia+ Services Free
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to unlock Luzia+ services for the next 15 minutes.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Only surfaces after an explicit paywall decline as a guest-friendly fallback. To prevent subscriber substitution, the session is capped at 15 minutes once per day. To enable stateless bookings and alerts during the guest session, the backend maps temporary session tokens to secure device IDs, restricting high-risk operations (such as actual purchases) until a full account is linked. Crucially, requests during guest trials route to a lower-cost distilled model (text-cheap) to guarantee positive margins in low-eCPM regions.

kpis.primary: Luzia+ subscription conversion rate among paywall decliners over 28 days
guardrails: Overall D7 and D30 user retention non-inferiority margin within -1%
Total paid subscription revenue per user (non-inferiority margin -3% relative)
kpis.holdout: Randomized user-level 10% holdout group ineligible for rewarded guest fallback passes for 28 days

risks: Users with very low task needs may defer signing up indefinitely if their brief daily trial session is sufficient.
Premium task execution costs could still be high in low-eCPM areas if the distilled model fails to satisfy complex user prompts.
